user_input: 请根据我上传的数据绘制折线图，展示 2015—2024 年平台注册用户数的增长（呈指数增长）；Y 轴使用对数坐标；折线添加数据点标记并标注数值（单位：万人）；添加图表标题、X 轴（年份）与 Y 轴（注册用户数/万人，对数刻度）标签，并加上图例。

```latex

\begin{axis}[
    title={2015—2024 年平台注册用户数增长趋势},

    xtick=data,
    symbolic x coords={2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024},
    width=12cm,
    height=8cm,
    ymode=log,
    log basis y={10},
    ymin=1, ymax=3000,
    nodes near coords,
    every node near coord/.append style={
        font=\scriptsize,
        fill=none,
        draw=none,
        inner sep=1pt,
        anchor=south
    },
    legend style={at={(1.03,0.5)}, anchor=west, draw=black, fill=white},
    mark=*,
    mark size=3pt,
    thick,
    grid=major,
    grid style={dashed, gray!30},
]
\addplot[blue, mark=*, thick] coordinates {
    (2015,2.5)
    (2016,6.8)
    (2017,18.4)
    (2018,46.2)
    (2019,105.7)
    (2020,230.5)
    (2021,468.9)
    (2022,860.3)
    (2023,1420.6)
    (2024,2150.4)
};
\legend{注册用户数}
\end{axis}
\node[anchor=north west, font=\scriptsize] at (axis description cs:0.0,-0.15) {数据来源：平台公开数据};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
